standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades the glued module to a finitely generated one.

core_obligations: Record that R -> R-hat is flat by the completion-flatness statement and that R/fR = R-hat/fR-hat (proof lines 25015-25017).

Use the completion-tensor statement to conclude that the completion of a finite R-module M equals M tensor_R R-hat, and hence that the displayed functor coincides with the functor of the formal gluing theorem; in particular it is fully faithful (proof lines 25018-25024).
Given an object (M_1, M_2, psi) of the right-hand category, use the formal gluing theorem to produce an R-module M with M_1 = M tensor_R R-hat and M_2 = M_f (proof lines 25024-25028).
Use that R -> R-hat x R_f is faithfully flat together with the cover criterion to conclude that M is finitely generated, so that M lies in the source category (proof lines 25028-25031).
difficulty_reason: The proposition takes a Noetherian ring R, an element f, and the f-adic completion R-hat, and asserts that the functor M -> (M-hat, M_f, can) defines an equivalence between finitely generated R-modules and the fibre product of finitely generated R-hat-modules and R_f-modules over finitely generated (R-hat)_f-modules (source lines 24998-25012). The proof identifies this functor with one already treated. It records that R -> R-hat is flat and that R/fR = R-hat/fR-hat, and that the completion of a finite R-module M equals M tensor_R R-hat, so that the displayed functor coincides with the functor of the formal gluing theorem; in particular it is fully faithful (proof lines 25015-25024). The substantive step is essential surjectivity: given an object (M_1, M_2, psi) of the right-hand category, the formal gluing theorem produces an R-module M with M_1 = M tensor_R R-hat and M_2 = M_f, and then the proof argues that M is finitely generated (proof lines 25024-25028). That last step uses that R -> R-hat x R_f is faithfully flat together with the cover criterion (proof lines 25028-25031). The non-routine content is the reduction of the equivalence statement for finitely generated modules to the unrestricted formal gluing theorem plus faithful flatness of the pair of maps.
